goals.title: Preserve publication Git config authority
goals.objective: Allow only genuinely immutable system config fallback while retaining writable lock and rewrite race defenses and complete bounded inventories.

successCriteria.scenario: Reject owner-controlled, ordinary non-current-UID, and drifting config while allowing the actual root-owned immutable macOS system config.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Go TempDir fixtures removed; external system config read only.

successCriteria.scenario: Parse all three >4096-byte config inventories completely with Git-canonical include interpolation and fail closed above 1 MiB without partial results.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Fake Git and inventory TempDir fixtures removed.

successCriteria.scenario: Keep existing writable config lock collision and rewrite-race regressions green and seal the initially absent XDG parent against transient create/rewrite/remove and same-UID whole-tree identity replacement during push (B79).
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Lock, script, marker, and repository TempDir fixtures removed.

goals.title: Use immutable implementation evidence
goals.objective: Prefer valid branch_prepare.base_sha over moving refs without breaking legacy records.

successCriteria.scenario: Retain implementation evidence after origin/main moves, reject unchanged HEAD, and preserve malformed/missing SHA fallback.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Temporary Git repository removed by Go TempDir cleanup.

goals.title: Verify final worker source
goals.objective: Pass focused and repository-wide quality gates without install or publication side effects.

successCriteria.scenario: Pass focused, full, race, vet, golden, skill validator, source build, and deterministic self-verify gates.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Attempt 3: all source gates exit 0 and self-verify state roots removed with verified absence; self-verify is blocked at the native-integration probe only by the absent host ~/.codex/hooks.json (B-80), whose restoration is coordinator-owned. Prior receipts retained as history.
